verdict.rationale: Thoropass's own docs say it connects evidence, progress, and auditors in one place, with every audit step in one platform. Audits and evidence requests live in the workspace, and comments on controls and evidence requests are centralized, which supports replacing email threads. However, no evidence describes a dedicated, permission-scoped auditor view or role of controls and evidence. Missing for 10: documented auditor role or scoped auditor permissions, a description of an auditor-facing view of controls and evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my auditor works directly in the platform — a scoped auditor view of controls and evidence replaces email threads of PDFs

citations.quote: Thoropass connects evidence, progress, and auditors in one place from kickoff to final report.
From scoping through final report, every step happens in one platform, so you spend less time managing the audit and more time strengthening your security program.
The new feature keeps all communication across Thoropass in one page, making managing Controls and Evidence Requests easier and faster.
